privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: What the game saves, how we use it and how to make a request about your data.

sections.title: Accounts and sign-in
paragraphs: If you sign up by email, we use your address to confirm your account and send password reset links. Our sign-in and storage provider handles account information and stores Classic and PvE progress.
If you sign in with an outside account, we use the information you allow that service to share to create or link your account. Your game profile uses your email and display name, if provided.

sections.title: What does the game save?
paragraphs: Classic and PvE save progress to your account, including squads, player names you enter, season results and career choices. Player age and nationality describe your character in the game.

Quick Mode saves your run in the browser tab you’re using. The game uses cookies and browser storage to keep you signed in, remember your language and reduced-motion preferences, and show your player’s reaction after a transfer.
Clearing site data may remove your Quick Mode run and preferences in that browser. Classic and PvE progress stays with your account.

sections.title: Security and abuse prevention
paragraphs: Our abuse prevention provider may handle your IP address, email address or account ID to limit repeated requests, such as too many sign-in attempts.

sections.title: Visit and play statistics
paragraphs: When analytics is enabled, the game uses a web analytics provider to count landing page visits, video plays and Quick Mode milestones.

Browser storage helps the game remember how you entered Quick Mode and avoid counting a start twice. The statistics may include how you entered the game, your browser window size category, a shortened page address and technical information from your visit.

sections.title: Where and for how long is data kept?
paragraphs: We still need to confirm where data is stored, whether it is sent abroad and how long we keep account information, saved games, logs, backups and support emails.

sections.title: Rights and data requests
paragraphs: You can change your display name in your profile. Use the email in the Contact section to ask what we hold about you, see it, get a copy, or ask us to correct or delete it. You can also request account deletion at that address.

Tell us what you want to do and include the email address linked to your account if you have one. We may need to verify your identity before acting on a request. Keep your password and verification codes private.

Depending on the law that applies, you may be able to ask us to limit how we use your information, object to its use or complain to the relevant authority. If the law requires us to ask for your permission for a particular purpose, we must ask separately for that purpose. You can withdraw permission you have given.

sections.title: Children’s data
paragraphs: Parents and guardians can use the email below to ask a question or make a request about a child’s data. Share only the details needed to describe the request.

sections.title: Contact
paragraphs: Use the email below for data requests, privacy questions or security reports. Our email provider handles your address and message so we can receive and reply to it.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: How to play Road to Glory, what we ask of players and where to get help.

sections.title: Free play and voluntary contributions
paragraphs: Road to Glory is a free, independent, fan-made football career simulation for the community. Weighted wheels generate simulated outcomes.

The game does not currently accept contributions. If we open a contribution channel, you can choose to support development and updates. Contributions do not buy access, in-game items, features or advantages.

sections.title: Accounts and age eligibility
paragraphs: You can play Quick Mode without an account. Classic and PvE require sign-in to save progress. Keep your sign-in details private.
Age eligibility and parent or guardian requirements are pending confirmation by release location and applicable game classification.

sections.title: Rules of use
paragraphs: Access only accounts and data you are authorized to use. Do not interfere with the system, disrupt the service or use automation to bypass limits or manipulate results.
When naming a squad or player, avoid other people’s personal information and content that infringes third-party rights.

sections.title: In-game values
paragraphs: Wages, transfer fees, budgets and points are simulated game values. They are used for play and do not represent real money or prizes.

sections.title: Content and ownership
paragraphs: Road to Glory is unaffiliated with and does not represent FIFA, Electronic Arts (EA SPORTS FC), or any football association, league or club named in the game. None of these organizations sponsors, funds or endorses the project.

Club names, competition names and related information are used in the simulation. Game content and results are not official information from those organizations. Playing the game does not transfer ownership of its software, artwork or content. Rights in third-party names, marks and materials remain with the relevant rights holders.

sections.title: Saved progress and interruptions
paragraphs: Quick Mode saves progress in the tab’s browser session. Closing the tab or clearing browser storage may remove the run. Classic and PvE save progress under the account.
Maintenance or incidents may temporarily interrupt the game. If you have trouble getting in or notice progress missing from your account, you can report it using the email below.

sections.title: Contact
paragraphs: Use the email below to report a bug, ask about these terms or make a complaint. You retain your rights under applicable law.
